newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Last Russian strategic forces quit Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Last Russian strategic forces quit Belarus.

text.p: The last Russian strategic missile forces have left the former Soviet republic of Belarus, Kremlin spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky said on Monday.
The last missiles themselves were formally removed from Belarussian territory last November.

Yastrzhembsky, who declined to say exactly when the last Russian personnel left, said President Boris Yeltsin had sent Belarussian President Alexander Lukashenko a message noting that the two countries had fulfilled their international obligations.
Russia has, under international arms control treaties, taken over the nuclear arsenals of all the former Soviet republics.
The spokesman said the SS-25 Topol (Poplar) missile systems taken from Belarus would continue to serve in Russia for the defence of both countries, which have a mutual defence treaty.
